product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native supply-chain planning, modeling, and decision-intelligence platform for enterprise supply-chain teams, helping them model, plan, and operate supply chains on one system.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage navigation and footer list no pricing page or pricing link.

named_customers.notes: Customer Stories page names these customers.

employee_band.notes: Official site did not provide a count; third-party results conflicted and no reliable exact band could be established.

hq_location.notes: Official Lyric company information identifies U.S. headquarters; LinkedIn lists Sunnyvale, California as headquarters.

eng_blog.notes: Readable blog index mainly contains product, business, and thought-leadership content; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about product implementation or underlying technical systems.

public_docs.notes: The homepage navigation and footer do not link to a public docs site, help center, or developer portal.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers board URL is identified, but its current openings could not be read or verified.

model_provider.notes: The official trust page says Lyric Studio runs on AWS but names no AI model provider; no specific provider was found in the available product, trust, or blog information.

compliance_certs.notes: Trust Hub says SOC 2 Type II reports are available by request. No other listed certification could be verified on the cited page.

last_funding.notes: Lyric’s dated announcement describes a $43.5 million Series B.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest round located was announced August 2025, before the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09; no later round was found.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Careers board is linked from the official site but current job titles and openings could not be read.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index available during research showed the newly promoted Crescendo experience (“New: Start your Supply Chain Engineer journey”), a product offering within the six-month window before 2026-11-09.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available About page did not provide a verifiable dated leadership roster or announcement sufficient to determine whether a C-level or VP joined or left in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable jobs, documentation, or integration listing naming CRM or sales/marketing systems was found.
